fullContent:
Amritabhallataka Ghrita 
 Reference: Ashtanga Hridayam Uttarasthana 39/75-77 
 Introduction 
 Amritabhallataka Ghrita is an Ayurvedic medicine, in herbal ghee form. It balances Vata and Kapha doshas in body. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Bhallataka – Purified Semecarpus anacardium – 3.072 kg 
 Water – 12.288 l 
 Milk – 3.840 l 
 Ghee – 3.940 
 Sugar – Quantity sufficient 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 The above combination is heated till herbal ghee is prepared. 
 Dosage 
 Take the quarter to half teaspoon of this medicine with water, usually before food, once or twice a day, or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Indications 
 
 Chronic skin diseases 
 Non bleeding piles 
 Leprosy 
 Diabetes 
 Dyspepsia 
 Weakness 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 There are no known side effects with this medicine. Take this medicine only under medical supervision. 
 It may worsen burning sensation and gastritis. 
 People with diabetes, high cholesterol, heart diseases and high BP should take it under caution. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
